name: oh-my-teams
description: Role agents (spec, implementer, reviewer, QA) and a lead skill that run a feature from spec to implementation with a chosen review level, a converging review loop and a knowledge lookup before each role starts.

default_level.title: Default review level
default_level.description: 0, 1, 2 or 3. When set, the lead uses this level without asking. Leave empty to be asked once per feature.

spec_model.title: Spec agent model
spec_model.description: sonnet, opus, haiku or fable. Leave empty to use the agent's default (opus).

implementer_model.title: Implementer model
implementer_model.description: sonnet, opus, haiku or fable. Leave empty to use the agent's default (sonnet).

reviewer_model.title: Reviewer model
reviewer_model.description: sonnet, opus, haiku or fable. Leave empty to use the agent's default (opus).

qa_model.title: QA model
qa_model.description: sonnet, opus, haiku or fable. Leave empty to use the agent's default (sonnet).

spec_dir.title: Spec folder
spec_dir.description: Folder where a spec is written when the discussion workflow names no path.

plan_dir.title: Plan folder
plan_dir.description: Folder where a plan is written when the discussion workflow names no path.
